measurement_method: Visual estimate of visible central cat from top of ears to lowest visible body/feet/tail; not automatic segmentation
size_semantics: Visible head-to-feet height in neutral standing pose, excluding transparent window padding. Width follows stickman proportions, not cat width.
dpi_semantics: Screenshot pixels are image pixels. Do not treat them as Windows DIPs; map through the actual display size and measured DPI at runtime.
status: Implementation sizing reference derived from leader's instruction to match the pictured cat; no application code changed
